name: Axelerated Solutions for Inform
summary: Axelerated Solutions for Information and Communication Technology, an enterprise based in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, specializes in delivering a broad spectrum of IT services. Their comprehensive offerings encompass critical infrastructure solutions, such as data center establishment, migration assistance, and robust disaster recovery and business continuity planning. The firm also provides an extensive suite of cybersecurity measures, including identity and access management, privileged access control, mobile device oversight, data encryption, and seamless single sign-on with multi-factor authentication. Complementing these are their managed IT services and comprehensive system integration capabilities, particularly focusing on automation deployment. Catering to a diverse clientele, Axelerated Solutions serves sectors such as telecommunications, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, government, defense, and retail. The company commenced operations in 2015.
